title: Grateful Dead Live at Alpine Valley Music Theatre on 1982-08-07
lineage: SBD > PCM > ? > D > Serafin Station mastering> CD

ai_review.summary: Soundboard capture of a high‑energy Alpine ’82 show featuring the legendary Music > Sugaree > Music sequence, with Jerry’s soaring vocals and tight band play; recording is clear but a bit thin.
ai_review.review: The concert is praised as one of the band’s finest from the summer of ’82, highlighted by an electrifying Music > Sugaree > Music segue, a flawless Althea, and Jerry Garcia’s voice soaring into “the ninth dimension.” The soundboard source delivers good clarity despite the typical thin‑ness of early‑’80s recordings, making it a must‑download for fans.

ai_rating.rationale: Reviews uniformly rate the show 4–5 stars and emphasize outstanding performance; recording is noted as good though slightly thin, yielding a high combined rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Generally clear and well‑balanced soundboard tape; some reviewers note the typical thin mids of 1982 recordings but no major dropouts or distortion.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Strong opener with the unique Music‑Sugaree‑Music segue, tight transitions throughout, and a high‑energy second half that kept the crowd engaged.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Voice described as on fire, soaring into 'the ninth dimension'; guitar work praised.
